member_pointer_contract.qualification: Three separate standalone globals only; no embedded664-byte context field, array stride, serialization or nonzero this adjustment is covered. These actual callback bodies remain named traps until reached.

_main.preserved_register_abi: Win32 cdecl/stdcall callees preserve EBX; all EBX/BX/BL/BH writes are checked through the actual POP EBX restores.
_main.scope: Finite main instruction intervals and exact COFF IAT relocations only; shared Rust retains full CFG/RET/reference/ownership/extent checks.

_initialize_debug@8.qualification: Finite EDI/EBP cache lifetimes through their restores, including getenv-NULL branch after the last cached call; ordinary cdecl/stdcall preserves these registers. Rust owns CFG discovery.

_initialize_repro.qualification: Bounded import cache lifetimes, explicit inline strcat pointer reuse and both restore paths; no independent CFG walk. All actual bodies retain common Rust CFG/RET/ref/ownership checks.

_parse_command_line@16.qualification: Exact whole-body register-write and incoming-branch certificate; cdecl/stdcall callees preserve EBX. Common Rust retains CFG, RET, references and ownership.

_has_switch@4.qualification: Exact whole-body EBP/BP writes and incoming branches; count-zero branch skips the cache and all calls. Every original return restores EBP. Common Rust owns CFG/RET/ref/ownership.

audit.qualification: Exact FF25 import leaves have no local RET; typed external ABI remains at imported-library boundary. Every actual application/CRT body retains strict RET comparison.
